# RAPT

> RAPT is an event-aware dynamic-pricing and revenue tool for short-term rental (STR) hosts. It monitors local events and demand around a property and recommends data-driven nightly rates, so independent hosts capture demand spikes and stop under-pricing mid-week nights. App at https://getrapt.app.

## What it does
- Scans local events within a radius of the host's property and assigns demand tiers
- Recommends nightly price ranges tied to the host's own base rate
- Helps small/independent hosts price like a revenue manager without an enterprise PMS

## How it works (high level)
- Enter your property location (zip / lat-long) and a base rate
- RAPT matches nearby events, assigns demand tiers, and suggests price ranges
- Optional weekly digest of upcoming local demand per property

## Who it's for
Independent and small-portfolio short-term rental hosts who want smarter, event-driven pricing without complex software.
